column4: orange

blue: The solution ID from the SDR. Not a new number. This is what makes the whole chain checkable.
column3: Copied from the SDR so the row can be read without opening another document.
column4: Passed, Failed, Partly passed or Ignored, as at the latest cycle.
column5: Every cycle, dated, newest at the bottom. Never overwrite the previous finding. The history is what shows whether a fix worked or moved the problem.
column6: Something agreed as acceptable rather than fixed. An exception is a decision and it needs to be written down.
column7: Who has to act next. Blank means nobody, which means it is done.
column9: Filled in by the Kestrel business team, not by the analytics team.

column4: Findings by cycle

blue: Every page load on the website
column4: 22 May: Page name arrives on the home page and the listing pages but is empty on every product page. The object is set by a later script. 29 May: Product pages now populate. Login status still Anonymous for a signed in customer on the account pages. 04 Jun: All eleven global objects present on all page types.

blue: Every virtual page load in the cart and checkout
column4: 22 May: The direct call fires on the first load as well as on each step change, so the checkout counts one page view too many. 29 May: Fixed on delivery and payment. Still double counting on the first cart view. 04 Jun: Cart view fixed. Named Day delivery view has no virtual page load at all, and that view was not in the walkthrough.
column5: Named Day view deferred to the Phase 1 patch release, agreed 04 Jun.

blue: A product is clicked on a listing page
column4: 22 May: Direct call fires twice on every click, so product clicks are exactly double. 29 May: Fires once. Listing type is Category Listing on the search results page. 04 Jun: Correct on all four listing types.

blue: A product detail page is viewed
column4: 22 May: Page load rule fires before the product objects exist, so every product view is empty. Changed to a direct call, see TSD change log 2. 29 May: Populates correctly. 04 Jun: Confirmed on twelve products across three categories.

blue: A product is added to the cart from the product page
column4: 22 May: Quantity is the cart total rather than the quantity being added, so a second add of the same product sends 2. 29 May: Correct. 04 Jun: Confirmed including quantity above one.

blue: A product is added to the cart from the quick view overlay
column4: 22 May: Cart source is Product Page rather than Quick View, so the two cannot be told apart. 29 May: Correct. 04 Jun: Confirmed.

blue: A product is removed from the cart
column4: 22 May: The whole cart is sent on a removal, so removing one product reports all of them removed. 29 May: Correct. 04 Jun: Confirmed.
22 May: Product string holds one entry with three IDs joined by commas inside it. 29 May: Rebuilt as an array, see TSD change log 3. Correct. 04 Jun: Confirmed with one, three and eleven products.
22 May: Fires again every time the customer goes back a step, inflating checkouts. 29 May: Fires once. 04 Jun: Confirmed.

22 May: Delivery charge is missing when the charge is zero, because the site treats zero as nothing to send. 29 May: Zero now sent as zero. 04 Jun: Confirmed on all four options including showroom collection.
22 May: Payment method arrives as the gateway code rather than the name. 29 May: Names correct for card and PayPal, still a code for Klarna. 04 Jun: All five correct.

22 May: Refreshing the confirmation page sends a second purchase, so revenue on the test account was double. 29 May: Guard added, see TSD change log 4. No duplicate across twenty refreshes. 04 Jun: Confirmed. Revenue matches the order system on all fourteen test orders.

22 May: No call at all. The failure view is served by the gateway and the site never regains control. 29 May: The gateway now returns to a site page and the call fires. Failure reason is a numeric code. 04 Jun: Card Declined and Cancelled by Customer map correctly. The three gateway timeout codes still arrive as numbers.
column5: Numeric timeout codes accepted for launch and classified in reporting instead, agreed 04 Jun.

column4: 22 May: Fires on a rejected code as well as an accepted one. 29 May: Fires only on accepted. 04 Jun: Confirmed on three codes.

blue: A search is run on the site
column4: 22 May: Result count arrives as a string, so no null search was ever recorded. 29 May: Rewritten, see TSD change log 5. Null searches now recorded. 04 Jun: Confirmed. Bucket processing rule correct.
22 May: Position counts from zero. 29 May: Counts from one. 04 Jun: Confirmed including promoted results.

22 May: Customer ID is the raw email address. Stopped testing and raised immediately. 29 May: Hashed on the server. Raw address no longer present anywhere in the data layer. 04 Jun: Confirmed on all four sign in methods.
22 May: No call. 29 May: Fires, but also on a failed registration. 04 Jun: Fires only on a created account.
22 May: No call. 29 May: No call. 04 Jun: Still no call. The session is cleared and the page reloads before the tag manager can see anything.

blue: A home page banner is clicked
column4: 22 May: Banner position is the campaign slot from the content system rather than the position on the page, so the same banner reports the same position everywhere. 29 May: Correct. 04 Jun: Confirmed.
22 May: Footer links do not fire. Header and main menu correct. 29 May: All three fire. Navigation level is Main Menu for footer links. 04 Jun: Correct.
22 May: Showroom city is the showroom location rather than the city searched for. 29 May: Correct. 04 Jun: Confirmed on eight searches.

blue: A form is started and a form is submitted
column4: 22 May: Direct call identifiers are formStart and formComplete rather than form_start and form_submit. Data element names also differ. 29 May: No change. 04 Jun: No change. The form component is owned by a third party and the change is not in their release window.
column5: Dropped from Phase 1 entirely. The trade account form is the only form in scope and it will be covered in the Phase 1 patch release. Agreed 04 Jun.

blue: An error is shown to the customer
column4: 22 May: Page not found fires but carries no URL, so the report says only that something was missing. 29 May: URL present. 04 Jun: Gateway and form validation errors also confirmed.
29 May: Paid search traffic is landing in Natural Search because the paid rule sits below the natural one. 04 Jun: Order corrected. All nine channels resolve.
04 Jun: Uploaded and applied. Twelve campaign codes classified, four with no name yet.
04 Jun: Applied. Buckets correct at zero, three, eleven and forty results.
29 May: Two rules fire before consent is answered. 04 Jun: All rules gated. No hit before an answer.
